about_the_game:
Unravel the Mysteries of Ghost in the Feed

As an agent of a secret organization, monitor cameras equipped with special modes to track supernatural phenomena, from moving furniture to spectral entities. One misstep could jeopardize everything. Will you stay vigilant enough to make it to dawn?

Gameplay That Tests Your Senses

Dynamic Surveillance: Switch between cameras to monitor multiple rooms per map, each with unique settings and an immersive atmosphere. Zoom and rotate to inspect every corner.

Five Camera Modes: Detect anomalies invisible to the naked eye using Normal, Infrared, Thermal, UltraViolet, and DOTS modes, each revealing different paranormal clues.

15 Types of Anomalies: From TVs turning on by themselves to doors opening on their own, ghostly orbs, and bloodstains, every night is unique.

Replayability: Every session is unique with random events selected from a pool of over a hundred, in an unpredictable order.

Difficulty: The 14 maps offer increasing complexity for a progressive challenge suitable for all players.

Why You’ll Love It

Perfect for fans of the genre, Ghost in the Feed blends a supernatural atmosphere with intense observation gameplay. With randomly triggered objects, a variety of anomalies, and an immersive atmosphere, each night tests your courage and focus. Will you uncover the secrets hidden in the video feeds, or will the shadows unnerve you?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 - 64 Bits
  • Processor: Intel i5 or new-gen i3 / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 / AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 12 GB available space

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
